sources.title: Pop Epoch Calculator 9.29 (1).xlsx
sources.notes: The workbook labels these as the very base hero value without personal bonuses. Values are recorded at green star 1. Workbook labels were mapped to the site roster only where the identity was clear; Anderson/Andersen is left unresolved.

sources.title: User-provided HeroSkale screenshots
sources.notes: Guan Yu stat-panel Held contributions transcribed from the image sequence. Original images are not copied into the repository.

sources.title: User-provided hero level readings
sources.notes: Guan Yu levels 23-53, Lü Bu levels 1/10/15, and Miyamoto Musashi level 1. K-suffixed display values are approximate because the game rounds them.

sources.title: User-provided hero panel readings in conversation
sources.notes: Held ANG and LP values transcribed from the supplied level, ascension, and panel readings. K/M display values are approximate. Ascension state is preserved as stated; levels above a known cap imply the prior ascension. The 77.98K ANG / 853.1K LP Guan Yu reading is level 151, as confirmed by the user.

model.fit: base ANG starts at 616; each level step k adds floor((985 + 114*k)/20)

excludedLevelNotes.43: Reported 8313 is an outlier; 8213 would fit the curve, but the corrected value is unconfirmed. Raw observation remains 8313.

model.crossHeroScaleHypothesis: Estimated hero level-1 held ANG = (observed held ANG minus known milestone bonuses) × 616 / reference held ANG at the observed level. This assumes the reference level-growth curve scales proportionally across heroes; this remains experimental. The level-300 bonus is currently transcribed from Queen Victoria and assumed universal for estimates.
model.rounding: The level increments use integer division and return whole ANG values. User K/M readings are approximate; the model is fitted to rounded observations and is not the confirmed game formula.
